about: Slate's entries for OpenClaw. `slate install` does all of this for you on a Mac with Slate installed. By hand: register the server with `openclaw mcp add slate --command slate --arg mcp --connect-timeout 30` (OpenClaw 2026.9.4 probes it before saving, and `slate mcp` can take longer than the default 5 seconds to answer on a busy Mac), or merge `openclaw_json` into ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json (JSON5) and restart the gateway. OpenClaw reads Slate's skills from ~/.agents/skills, where the installer links each one to the checkout's skills/ folder, and only when the gateway uses its default state folder. Its PATH lacks ~/.local/bin, so the `slate` command is also linked into /opt/homebrew/bin. If OpenClaw refuses the linked skills, add the checkout's skills/ folder to skills.load.allowSymlinkTargets.

denied_connector_tools.why: Higgsfield's hosted connector can upload a person's skills and a personality profile, and publish to TikTok or a website. Slate never calls these. OpenClaw has no Higgsfield connector today; if one is ever added for an agent that runs autonomous films, deny these tools there.
